title: Space editors get the Journey admin rail and owner access on their Space's Journeys

source.ref: Journey audit 2026-11-17 (project thread: Dial in the Journey Wizard and Journeys)

detail: canEditJourney (lib/journeys/authoring.ts) lets a manager of the owning Space edit its Journeys (team authoring, LIVE-732), but getJourneyCapabilities never passed viewerManagesScope, so the resolver granted journey.editSettings only to the author and staff. A Space editor opening a teammate's Space Journey got no Settings, Builder, Export or Sell rail modules (getJourneyRailData / getJourneySellData return null), no Manage trigger on the Journey page, and startJourneyRunAction treated them as a non-owner (price and tier gates, and 'Journey not found' on a private draft). Fixed 2026-11-17: getJourneyCapabilities reads the plan's space_id and, for a non-root Space, sets viewerManagesScope from getSpaceCapabilities(...).canEditProfile, the same rule canEditJourney and the event capabilities use. The root Space is everyone's personal home, so managing it grants nothing here.

verify.note: Fails if getJourneyCapabilities stops computing viewerManagesScope from the owning non-root Space.
